name: mRAG-benchmark-chartqa
description: mRAG-benchmark-chartqa measures a model's ability to answer questions about charts and plots by combining visual understanding of chart elements (axes, legends, data series) with retrieval-augmented generation. It tests multimodal reasoning over images of charts and associated textual context to produce concise factual answers. The benchmark emphasizes correct interpretation of numeric and categorical information presented visually.
reputation: A specialized dataset in chart/visual QA research with modest adoption among multimodal VQA and data-visualization communities.
